# TuneShape · 随形

> UI motion editor and public rendering-source collection. 42 current effects with runnable examples, exact default configurations, English/Chinese notes, and preserved third-party attribution.

Website: https://tuneshape.kai-nex.com/
Repository: https://github.com/orocoa/TuneShape
Catalog: https://github.com/orocoa/TuneShape/blob/main/effects/catalog.json
English: https://github.com/orocoa/TuneShape/blob/main/README.md
Chinese: https://github.com/orocoa/TuneShape/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md
License: TuneShape-authored code is MIT; third-party code and fonts retain the notices accompanying their source.
Scope: Effect renderers and examples are public. The full website editor and deployments are maintained separately.

English effect guides: https://tuneshape.kai-nex.com/en/effects/
中文动效说明: https://tuneshape.kai-nex.com/effects/

## Effects

- [Button Press Feedback / 按钮按压反馈](https://github.com/orocoa/TuneShape/tree/main/effects/examples/basic-button) · [English guide](https://tuneshape.kai-nex.com/en/effects/button-press/) · [中文说明](https://tuneshape.kai-nex.com/effects/button-press/): Button Press Feedback · Duration spring · 420 ms / bounce 0.25
- [Hover Color Transition / 悬停配色过渡](https://github.com/orocoa/TuneShape/tree/main/effects/examples/hover-invert) · [English guide](https://tuneshape.kai-nex.com/en/effects/hover-invert/) · [中文说明](https://tuneshape.kai-nex.com/effects/hover-invert/): Hover Color Transition · 220 ms · Reprise
